fields.title: Source column
fields.description: The column containing the paths to the files/folders that must be compressed.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Create missing folders
fields.description: If enabled, missing folders in the specified path will be created automatically.

fields.title: If exists
fields.description: Specify the behavior of the node in case the output file already exists.

fields.title: Archive entry path
fields.description: This mode determines what the folder structure looks like when you de-compress the archive.

choices.label: Include all folders in the source path
Include all folders in the source path succeeding the prefix

fields.title: Folder prefix
fields.description: The path prefix to strip from the beginning of each source path. Folders matching this prefix will not be created when de-compressing the archive.

fields.title: Entry name column
fields.description: The column containing the archive entry names. Both path columns and string columns are accepted. When de-compressing, the created folder structure will match the entries in this column.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Compression
fields.description: The compression/archive format to use for the output file. Supported formats: zip, jar, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, cpio. If the compression format is changed, the file extension of the archive is adapted automatically.

fields.title: Include empty folders
fields.description: If enabled, empty folders found within the source path will be included in the archive.
